title_en: Auntie Wang by the Trash Bins
note_en: 把 moves the object in front of the verb when something is done to it and the result matters: 把垃圾分成四类 "sort the trash into four kinds"; 把外卖盒里的剩饭倒进厨余垃圾桶 "tip the leftovers from the takeout container into the food-waste bin." After the verb there's usually a result or direction (成, 进, 到) — the verb can't stand "bare." In English the object simply follows the verb.
